t: 贡多巴德(英语:Nephew of Ricimer)提名格来塞留斯为西罗马帝国皇帝.
te: Gundobad (nephew of Ricimer) nominates Glycerius as emperor of the Western Roman Empire.
dz: 贡多巴德(英语:Nephew of Ricimer)提名格来塞留斯为西罗马帝国皇帝.
de: Gundobad (nephew of Ricimer) nominates Glycerius as emperor of the Western Roman Empire.

t: 皇帝利奥一世称赞他的外孙利奥二世为东罗马帝国的凯撒.
te: Emperor Leo I acclaims his grandson Leo II as Caesar of the East Roman Empire.
dz: 皇帝利奥一世称赞他的外孙利奥二世为东罗马帝国的凯撒.
de: Emperor Leo I acclaims his grandson Leo II as Caesar of the East Roman Empire.
